topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture themes and outlines the learning objectives regarding cancer evolution and the tumor microenvironment.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic drivers of clonal evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how cell-intrinsic genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages during clonal succession and tumor initiation.

topics.label: Cell of origin and cancer stem cell hierarchies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how normal tissue hierarchies and stemness properties govern tumor initiation and propagation in leukemia and intestinal models.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory promotion of tumor growth
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how extrinsic inflammatory signals and microenvironmental dependencies promote malignant progression in incipient and established tumors.

topics.label: Technologies for profiling tumor evolution and spatial architecture
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic reviews the genomic, transcriptomic, and spatial methods used to investigate clonal dynamics and microenvironmental interactions in tumors.

topics.label: Integrated evolutionary model of cancer development
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic synthesizes how genetic mutations, cell-of-origin properties, and microenvironmental factors converge to drive cancer evolution.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture and indicates the topic of the following session.
